caption: The drawing shows a single tin lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top, featuring a curved handle attached at the pointed apex. The lantern is rendered in muted metallic tones including shades of gray, brown, and a hint of blue-green, giving the appearance of aged or weathered metal. The body of the lantern displays a rectangular door on the front, decorated with an arched, symmetrical punched-tin pattern consisting of rows of semi-circular indentations and small perforations forming a border. The conical top has evenly spaced round holes for ventilation as well as a faint, stamped leafy or feather-like design around its lower edge. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, allowing the lantern to be the sole focus of the composition with no other visible objects or shadows.
title: Lantern
